queriedAt.zh: 2026 年 10 月 23 日傍晚（柏林时间）

intro.zh: 日期灵活（周四 26 日 / 周五 27 日 / 周六 28 日），目的地维也纳市区。一天就能到，不需要中途过夜。关键是：用 Deutschlandticket 免费坐 RE50 到德累斯顿，再买德累斯顿 → 维也纳的票；而且这条线上 ÖBB 的特价票常常比 DB 便宜。
intro.en: Flexible dates (Thu 26 / Fri 27 / Sat 28), ending in central Vienna. It's doable in one day, no overnight stop needed. The key moves: ride the RE50 to Dresden for free on the Deutschlandticket, then buy only Dresden → Vienna; and on this line ÖBB's discount fares are often cheaper than DB's.

items.zh: 最便宜：A · RE50 到德累斯顿 + FlixBus 白天直达，约 20–23€。周四 26 日最便宜（20.49€），下午 15:45 到维也纳。
items.en: Cheapest: A · RE50 to Dresden + daytime FlixBus direct, about €20–23. Thursday the 26th is cheapest (€20.49), arriving in Vienna at 15:45.

items.zh: 坐火车最便宜：B · RE50 到德累斯顿 + ÖBB 特价票，约 27–29€。比大巴贵 6€ 左右，但 15:49 直接到维也纳中央火车站，车上舒服得多。
items.en: Cheapest by train: B · RE50 to Dresden + ÖBB discount fare, about €27–29. Around €6 more than the bus, but it arrives at Wien Hauptbahnhof at 15:49 and is far more comfortable.

items.zh: 夜车：E · 德累斯顿 22:10 → 维也纳 07:00，6 人卧铺 70€ 起。贵很多，但第二天一早就到，整个白天都能用。
items.en: Night train: E · Dresden 22:10 → Vienna 07:00, 6-berth couchette from €70. Much pricier, but you arrive first thing and have the whole day.

alert.zh: 三个日期里 26 日（周四）普遍最便宜，27 日周五最贵。DB 官网的联程票（D，38–45€）反而不是最便宜的：同一条线 ÖBB 卖得更便宜，Omio 上能看到 ÖBB 的票价。
alert.en: Of the three dates, the 26th (Thursday) is generally cheapest and Friday the 27th most expensive. DB's through ticket (D, €38–45) is not the cheapest: ÖBB sells the same journey for less, and Omio shows ÖBB's fares.

dateTableNote.zh: 「≈」是 Omio 日历上当天的最低价，没有逐班核对是哪一班。* 28 日的夜车价格是一个月前的数据，可能已经涨了。D-Ticket 覆盖的 RE50 不计钱。夜车这一行按出发日期排。
dateTableNote.en: "≈" is the day's lowest price on Omio's calendar, not checked train by train. * The night-train price for the 28th is a month old and may have gone up. The RE50 covered by the D-Ticket counts as €0. The night-train row is listed by departure date.

overviewTitle.zh: 总览（以 27 日周五为例）

overviewNote.zh: 换乘次数算上了莱比锡 → 德累斯顿的 RE50。每条都在 3 次以内。
overviewNote.en: Change counts include the RE50 from Leipzig to Dresden. Every route stays within 3 changes.

name.zh: RE50 到德累斯顿 + FlixBus 直达维也纳
name.en: RE50 to Dresden + FlixBus direct to Vienna

what.zh: RE50，每小时整点一班，D-Ticket 免费
what.en: RE50, hourly on the hour, free with D-Ticket

what.zh: FlixBus 直达，约 6.5 小时；Erdberg 是维也纳长途汽车站，旁边就是地铁 U3
what.en: FlixBus direct, about 6.5 hours; Erdberg is Vienna's long-distance coach station, right next to the U3 metro

item.zh: 莱比锡 → 德累斯顿 RE50

where.zh: flixbus.de；26 日 20.49€，27 日 23.49€，28 日 23.49€
where.en: flixbus.de; €20.49 on the 26th, €23.49 on the 27th, €23.49 on the 28th

notes.en: Plenty of daytime direct buses: 09:20, 09:50, 11:50, 12:20, 13:50, 15:50. The 15:50 is cheapest (€19.49 on the 26th, €21.99 on the 27th) but only arrives at 22:05.

notes.zh: RE50 和大巴是分开的票，RE50 晚点没有保护。坐 07:00 那班有 46 分钟余量；就算误了，后面 09:50、11:50 还有车，改签要另付差价。
notes.en: The RE50 and the bus are separate tickets, so a late RE50 is not protected. Taking the 07:00 gives a 46-minute buffer; even if you miss the bus, there are 09:50 and 11:50 departures, though rebooking costs the fare difference.

notes.zh: 夜里出发的大巴（00:30、02:20、03:00 等）按你的要求不考虑。
notes.en: Night-time buses (00:30, 02:20, 03:00 etc.) are excluded as you asked.

name.zh: RE50 到德累斯顿 + ÖBB 特价票
name.en: RE50 to Dresden + ÖBB discount fare

what.zh: RJ 171 → EC 279 → EC 205，在布拉格等站换车 2 次
what.en: RJ 171 → EC 279 → EC 205, changing twice, including in Prague

item.zh: 莱比锡 → 德累斯顿 RE50
德累斯顿 → 维也纳（ÖBB 票价）

where.zh: Omio 上 ÖBB 卖 29€；也可以去 oebbtickets.at 直接买（这次没有在 ÖBB 官网核实）。同一班车 bahn.de 加 BahnCard 25 是 49.99€
where.en: ÖBB sells it for €29 on Omio; you can also buy direct at oebbtickets.at (not verified on ÖBB's own site this time). The same train on bahn.de with BahnCard 25 is €49.99

notes.zh: 想少换乘：同样 09:10 出发，RJ 171 → RJ 253 只换 1 次，16:49 到，ÖBB 35€。还有 08:09 的 RJX 251 直达（14:54 到，不用换车），但 DB 卖 49.99€、ÖBB 卖 75€，贵很多。
notes.en: For fewer changes: same 09:10 departure, RJ 171 → RJ 253 with just 1 change, arriving 16:49, €35 with ÖBB. There's also the 08:09 RJX 251 direct (arrives 14:54, no change), but DB charges €49.99 and ÖBB €75.

notes.zh: RE50 和 ÖBB 票是分开的，RE50 晚点没有保护。建议坐 07:00 的 RE50（36 分钟余量），稳妥一点坐 06:00 的。
notes.en: The RE50 and the ÖBB ticket are separate, so a late RE50 is not protected. Take the 07:00 RE50 (36-minute buffer), or the 06:00 to be safe.

name.zh: ÖBB 联程票，从莱比锡出发

item.zh: 莱比锡 → 维也纳（ÖBB 票价）

where.zh: Omio 上 ÖBB 卖 33€；同一班车 bahn.de 加 BC25 是 69.99€
where.en: ÖBB sells it for €33 on Omio; the same train on bahn.de with BC25 is €69.99

notes.zh: 只比 B 贵 4€，但是一张联程票：中间哪一段晚点，后面的车都有保护。缺点是出发晚，晚上 19 点才到。
notes.en: Only €4 more than B, and it's one through ticket: if any leg runs late, the following trains are covered. The downside is a late start and a 19:00 arrival.

name.zh: DB 联程票，05:49 直达布拉格再转车
name.en: DB through ticket, 05:49 direct to Prague, then change

what.zh: RJ 277；在布拉格换乘 12 分钟

where.zh: bahn.de + BahnCard 25，Sparpreis Europa；26 日 37.99€，27 日 44.99€，28 日 39.99€。Omio 上这一班 35€（不认 BahnCard）
where.en: bahn.de + BahnCard 25, Sparpreis Europa; €37.99 on the 26th, €44.99 on the 27th, €39.99 on the 28th. Omio shows €35 for this train (no BahnCard discount)

notes.zh: 下午 13:49 就到，是白天方案里最早的，但要 5 点多出门。
notes.en: Arrives at 13:49, the earliest of the daytime options, but you leave home before 6.

notes.zh: 两次换乘都比较短（12 分钟、8 分钟）。这是联程票，误车可以改坐后面的车。
notes.en: Both changes are fairly short (12 and 8 minutes). It's a through ticket, so if you miss a connection you can take the next train.

name.zh: Nightjet NJ 457，德累斯顿 → 维也纳

tag.zh: 夜车 · 第二天一早到
tag.en: Night train · arrives early next morning

what.zh: RE50，D-Ticket 免费；19:00 那班更稳妥
what.en: RE50, free with D-Ticket; the 19:00 is the safer choice

t.zh: 22:10 Dresden Hbf → 次日 07:00 Wien Hbf
t.en: 22:10 Dresden Hbf → 07:00 next day Wien Hbf

what.zh: NJ 457（柏林开来），6 人卧铺 couchette；22:02 也可以在 Dresden-Neustadt 上车
what.en: NJ 457 (from Berlin), 6-berth couchette; you can also board at Dresden-Neustadt at 22:02

item.zh: 莱比锡 → 德累斯顿 RE50

where.zh: nightjet.com / oebbtickets.at 或 bahn.de。26 日出发 70–71€，27 日出发 86€（ÖBB，4 天前的数据），4 人卧铺 80–100€。只坐座位 35–36€
where.en: nightjet.com / oebbtickets.at or bahn.de. €70–71 departing the 26th, €86 departing the 27th (ÖBB, data from 4 days ago); 4-berth €80–100. Seat only €35–36

notes.zh: 好处：睡一觉就到，早上 7 点到维也纳，整个白天都能用；如果你本来就要在维也纳住，还能省一晚住宿。
notes.en: Upside: sleep and you're there: Vienna at 7 a.m. with the whole day ahead, and if you were staying in Vienna anyway, you save a night's accommodation.

notes.zh: 代价：比 A 贵 50–60€；6 人卧铺睡得不如床；每晚只有这一班，没有后备。
notes.en: Cost: €50–60 more than A; a 6-berth couchette is not a bed; only one train a night, no backup.

notes.zh: Nightjet 的卧铺车厢可以订女生专用包厢（Damenabteil），订票时选上。
notes.en: Nightjet couchettes can be booked as a women-only compartment (Damenabteil); select it when booking.

notes.zh: 价格来自 Night Ride 汇总的 ÖBB 和 DB 报价，是几天前的快照，夜车越临近越贵。
notes.en: Prices come from Night Ride's summary of ÖBB and DB fares, a snapshot from a few days ago; night trains get pricier closer to departure.

why.zh: 白天只有 11:00 → 19:15 一班直达，27 日 50.99€；比先坐 RE50 到德累斯顿再坐大巴贵一倍多，到得还晚。
why.en: Only one daytime direct bus, 11:00 → 19:15, €50.99 on the 27th; more than double the price of RE50-to-Dresden-then-bus, and it arrives later.

name.zh: 德累斯顿 → 布拉格 → 维也纳，全坐 RegioJet
name.en: Dresden → Prague → Vienna, all on RegioJet

why.zh: 大巴 14.90€ + 火车 16.90€，约 32€，比 A 贵、比 B 慢，没有优势。
why.en: Bus €14.90 + train €16.90, about €32: dearer than A and slower than B, no advantage.

why.zh: 当天就能到维也纳，中途过夜只会多花住宿钱。
why.en: You can reach Vienna the same day; stopping overnight only adds accommodation cost.

why.zh: 没有查。火车和大巴最低 20–45€，坐飞机还要去机场、加托运行李，不会更划算。
why.en: Not checked. Train and bus start at €20–45; flying adds airport transfers and checked bags, so it won't come out cheaper.

paragraphs.zh: 假设：1 位成人，二等座，BahnCard 25，Deutschlandticket，普通行李。夜车按 6 人卧铺报价。
paragraphs.en: Assumptions: 1 adult, second class, BahnCard 25, Deutschlandticket, normal luggage. Night trains priced as a 6-berth couchette.

paragraphs.zh: 比价来源：bahn.de、Omio（含 ÖBB 票价）、FlixBus、RegioJet、Night Ride（夜车）。Google 地图对 27 日推荐的是 07:25 IC → RJ 171 → EC → EC，15:49 到（就是 DB 3 次换乘的那班），它没有找到 05:49 直达布拉格的 EC，也没有找到「RE50 + 德累斯顿出发的大巴」。ÖBB 官网这次没有直接核实，Omio 上的 ÖBB 价格可能含少量手续费。Interrail 只卖通票，不卖单程票，所以没用来比价。
paragraphs.en: Price sources: bahn.de, Omio (including ÖBB fares), FlixBus, RegioJet, Night Ride (night trains). For the 27th Google Maps suggested 07:25 IC → RJ 171 → EC → EC, arriving 15:49 (the DB 3-change option); it did not find the 05:49 EC direct to Prague, nor "RE50 + bus from Dresden". ÖBB's own site was not checked directly this time, and ÖBB prices on Omio may include a small fee. Interrail only sells passes, not single tickets, so it wasn't used for price comparison.
